_readme: target/ops/golden-master.json -- which legacy outputs are compared with which target exports (golden_master.py).
kind=records: fixed-width images keyed by the store's primary key; layout comes from 5-data/mapping.json for `store` (or an explicit `layout` [[name,offset,length,'text'|'zoned'],...]).
runtime_fields: columns the program sets from the clock; both sides must match runtime_patterns[<field>] (or '*') to count as explained.
kind=text: line-by-line after noise_patterns are removed; labelled_values=true compares '<label>:<zoned value>' listing lines as decimals.
use_cases: the UC ids this pair proves -- feeds use_case_coverage.py.

explanations.runtime field: value set from the run's clock (rule <BR-nnnn>); the shape is compared and identical
explanations.sign representation: GnuCOBOL DISPLAY prints a trailing sign where IBM prints an overpunch letter; both decode to the same decimal
